title_zh: 确定火山模型演示的观察重点

scenario.label_zh: 确定火山模型演示的观察重点
scenario.goal_zh: 商定先观看演示再重播，分别记录物质出现和喷发的时刻

context_zh: 两名学生在科学馆观看数字火山模型，准备课堂观察记录。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Jasper
sentences.text: Does this model show what happens before a volcano starts to erupt?

sentences.speaker: Alina
sentences.text: Yes. Watch the crack on the left. You can see red material begin to emerge there.

sentences.speaker: Jasper
sentences.text: I missed the change because I was writing. Can we watch it once without taking notes?

sentences.speaker: Alina
sentences.text: Good idea. Then we can replay it and record when the material first appears and when the main eruption begins.

sentences.speaker: Jasper
sentences.text: Let us do that. We should describe what the model shows, not pretend we observed a real volcano.

sentences.speaker: Alina
sentences.text: Agreed. I will put the name of the model at the top of our notes.
